title: Channels of Impact: User Reviews When Quality Is Dynamic and Managers Respond
authors: Judith A. Chevalier; Yaniv Dover; Dina Mayzlin
near_miss_reason: Treatment timing (a hotel's first managerial response on TripAdvisor) is hotel-specific, but every main-text column (Tables 7-13) is a cross-sectional event-window regression on responding hotels only: the TripAdvisor change in reviewing activity 6 (10, 20) weeks after vs before the hotel's own response date, net of geographic neighbours, regressed on the same double differences for Orbitz and Priceline (or Expedia, Hotels.com). No untreated comparison units, no calendar-time fixed effects, control-platform outcomes enter as regressors; this is a stacked/event-window design, not a unit x calendar-time panel.
eligible_reason: No qualifying column. The 'multiple-differences' specification is estimated on hotel-level pre/post aggregates around each hotel's response initiation (only responding hotels), with control-site double differences on the right-hand side and pweights; there is no unit and calendar-time FE panel. The shipped data contain only hotel-level before/after aggregates with no hotel identifier or dates, so a panel cannot be reconstructed.
design_notes: basic_specification_focal_ta_6wks_final_jc_new.do: reg df_df_ta_numrevs df_df_orb_numrevs df_df_pricel_numrevs if ta_numrevs_bef~=. & has_response==1 [pweight=weight], robust (Table 7 col 1; cols 2-5 avg star, length). Table 8 (Expedia), Table 9 (Hotels.com), Tables 10-11 (bad/good first-day reviews), Table 12 (10-week window), Table 13 (shifted placebo windows). Tables 15-16: online experiment.
data_files_note: Hotel-level pre/post aggregates (2,825 rows in TA file) with derived double differences and weights; STR tier data (online appendix Table 1) withheld under license.
data_provenance_note: Authors' aggregated analysis files (hotel-level before/after windows); no panel, no identifiers or dates.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; table mapping from the package README docx. Near-miss recorded because response initiation is staggered across hotels, but the design is event-window only.
